title: Small limits in Grothendieck abelian categories
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with Hom sets in a fixed universe $\mathcal U$, and take its small colimits relative to $\mathcal U$. For every $\mathcal U$-small category $I$ and every functor $D:I\to\mathcal B$ there is a limit: an object $L$ and morphisms $\pi_i:L\to D(i)$ with $D(a)\pi_i=\pi_j$ for every $a:i\to j$, such that any other such cone admits exactly one map to $L$ commuting with all the $\pi_i$.
